name: Lemon Thai
summary: Lemon Thai is a [[kind:cultivar|cultivar]] credited to [[breeder:Dutch Flowers]], a cross of [[thai|Thai]] and [[hawaiian|Hawaiian]] stock. It is best known as one of the parents commonly given for OG Kush. Its release date is not recorded.

sources.title: Lemon Thai
sources.note: Planner-verified 2026-09-24: confirms the Thai x Hawaiian cross, Dutch Flowers as producer, and a flowering time of about 10 weeks, indoors and out.
